name: RxRx3-core
description: RxRx3-core is a compact high-content screening microscopy benchmark for zero-shot drug-target interaction inference. It evaluates whether representation learning models can infer perturbation similarity and drug-target relationships from cellular images without task-specific supervision, using a curated subset of the RxRx3 dataset designed to lower the storage and access barrier for HCS research.
evaluation_method: Top-k retrieval and classification metrics for zero-shot DTI prediction, typically accuracy/AUROC and rank-based retrieval measures on held-out perturbations or targets
notes: Curated and compressed subset of RxRx3 (18GB) intended for accessible benchmarking. The benchmark centers on high-content microscopy images spanning many CRISPR perturbations and chemical conditions. Exact state-of-the-art scores are not established in the provided metadata.
